description: Write evidence-bound submission materials for OpenAI Skills-only plugins without inventing facts or performing portal actions.

capabilities: Write evidence-bound Skills-only plugin listing copy
Prepare starter prompts and five positive plus three negative review cases
Detect missing, conflicting, or unverified submission evidence
defaultPrompt: Turn these approved Skills-only product facts and test results into a submission pack.
Prepare listing copy, starter prompts, review cases, and release notes from this evidence.
Check these Skills-only submission materials for missing or conflicting evidence.
interface.longDescription: Turn approved Skills-only product facts and current-version test evidence into listing copy, capabilities, starter prompts, five positive and three negative review cases, and release notes. Missing or conflicting evidence remains explicit. The plugin does not judge product quality, operate the OpenAI portal, submit, publish, or guarantee approval.

name: skill-submission-pack-writer
